release.notes: Vehicle search: Brand and Model in Settings now have a search box (accents and punctuation ignored; also finds models, platforms and older brand names). MEB: lifetime parked time and time parked at ~100 % / above 90 % SoC in All Sensors. Regen no longer counts as charging on Tesla S/X classic and MG; charging now detected on Evoque P300e and BAW Pony. New: Skyworth EV6 86 cells with vLinker MS, Lynk & Co 02 12 V and DC/DC, Trailseeker rear motor, MG4 Urban 43/54 FWD.
